claim_a.claim_text: High-quality external region proposals (e.g. Selective Search) are the foundation of accurate region-based detection.
claim_a.evidence_quote: Our system ... applies high-capacity convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to bottom-up region proposals in order to localize and segment objects ... we use selective search to generate category-independent region proposals.

claim_b.claim_text: An integrated Region Proposal Network is faster and equally accurate, removing the dependence on external proposal algorithms.
claim_b.evidence_quote: We introduce a Region Proposal Network (RPN) that shares full-image convolutional features with the detection network, thus enabling nearly cost-free region proposals.

rationale: Both detection pipelines are valid, but Faster R-CNN explicitly identifies external Selective Search proposals as the bottleneck and replaces them; this contradicts R-CNN's architectural premise that the proposal stage must be external.
